messages:
Marina (sales): Quick heads-up — closed Aurora Health (mid-market) today. Deal details in brief: annual Dedicated contract ~$180k ARR, private VPC required, HIPAA addendum signed. Target go-live ~2025-03-21. Committed throughput ~200 req/s typical, peaks ~400 in mornings. Models: rw-3-small quantized for gen + embeddings. SSO via Okta (SAML). Procurement flagged potential budget freeze around renewal (renewal risk). Main contacts: claire@aurorahealth.com (infra) and rob@aurorahealth.com (data). I'll drop the SF link and signed contract in the channel.

Devon (cs): Thanks Marina — I'll own the CSM onboarding. Assigning owners: Liam for infra/provisioning, Sanjay for SE/runbook, Anya for support readiness. @Liam @Sanjay @Anya please ack and call out any immediate blockers.

Liam (cs-ops): Ack — I can take infra. Need clarification on GPU preference (A100 vs H100), exact RPS/token profile, and whether staging needs its own VPC. Also confirm network peering vs VPN.

Marina (sales): Config snapshot from the customer:

```
deployment: Private VPC
region: us-west-2
expected_tokens_per_request: 120
avg_daily_qps: 80
peak_morning_qps: 400
sso: Okta SAML (metadata available)
data_classification: PHI
contract_term: annual
renewal_window: 2026-03-01
```

They asked for A100 initially but said H100 is fine if it reduces latency/cost. Procurement may push 60-day invoice terms — flagged as a renewal/billing risk.

Anya (support-eng): I'll start the support readiness checklist. Need: SSO metadata, cert rotation cadence, required logs/audit retention (HIPAA -> 7 years?), and whether they require separate staging env. Also, who is the on-call for HIPAA incidents on their side?

Sanjay (solutions-eng): I'll put together a kickoff deck and initial evals/runbook. Please share sample prompts and a few golden-output examples to build regression tests. Also need SLO ask: Marina, do they call out latency target? We should confirm P95 target for generation.

Marina (sales): They asked for ~250ms p95 for short completions in the deck, but said they understand it depends on model/seq length. I'll confirm in kickoff. Sending sample prompts and SF deal link now.

Devon (cs): Action items + owners (tracking):
1) Marina — share SF deal link, signed contract, and customer contacts (EOD today).
2) Liam — infra capacity estimate, staging VPC plan, and VPN/peering ops ticket (due Thu).
3) Sanjay — kickoff deck, eval harness, and regression prompt set (due Thu).
4) Anya — support runbook checklist, escalation chain, and HIPAA audit requirements (due Fri).
I'll schedule a 60-min kickoff with Aurora + CS/SE/Support.

Marina (sales): Kickoff booked: Wed 2025-02-12 10:00 PT — invite sent to Claire/Rob and our team. Flagging procurement risk: they might push extended payment terms; CSM please monitor renewal signal :eyes:

Liam (cs-ops): Opening infra ticket now -> INFRA-5219 (aurora-health - capacity + vpc). Adding estimated timeline and owners.

deploy-bot: Ticket INFRA-5219 created by Liam. ETA: 5 business days. Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-5219

Devon (cs): Great work — I'll add a weekly renewal_watch note to the account health dashboard and pin this thread to #aurora-health-activation. Any blockers before kickoff?

Sanjay (solutions-eng): No blockers from me. I'll draft the deck and post a PR to the shared drive for review.

Anya (support-eng): No blockers; will prepare the HIPAA support checklist and sample runbook entries.

Marina (sales): Thanks team — leaving the customer contact handoff in the SF record and adding the signed contract. Reach out if anything else needed before Wed.
